# The fees paid from savings in
# usd_moved_with_a_fee_in_a_book_keeping_no_usd_cost_basis.txt corrected from
# 150.00 USD to 80.00 USD, with `--strategy update`.
#
# At 150.00 the split took savings from 100.00 to −50.00 and brought 50.00 in
# on the owed side, which the import recorded on it. At 80.00 savings stays at
# 20.00, so the split brings nothing in past zero, and the record goes. The
# transaction touches no cost basis — the book keeps none for US dollars — so
# the edit is made in place.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
